answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 347 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the garden. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the summit queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. The jade index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 166 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
